title: Standard Deviation

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

explanation: Measures the typical spread of data points around the mean. The sample formula (dividing by n − 1) is used when the data represent a sample from a larger population, which is the more common case in lab replicate measurements; the population formula (dividing by n) is used only when the data set represents the entire population of interest.

variables.meaning: The arithmetic mean of all values

workedExample.scenario: Replicate counts of 28, 31, and 30 (mean 29.67), sample SD.

commonMistakes: Using the population formula (÷n) for what is actually a sample of replicates, which slightly underestimates the true spread.
